description: Add CornerHeatmap component showing per-corner degradation stress across laps using shap_data.json. Renders as a grid of 4 Silverstone corners x N laps with color gradient from near-black (low stress) to red (high stress).

userStories.title: Add corner stress heatmap over laps
userStories.description: As an F1 engineer, I want to see which Silverstone corners generate the most degradation stress per lap so I can identify where tire wear originates.
acceptanceCriteria: Component accepts props: { year: number, driver: string }
Import shap_data from '../../../public/data/shap_data.json' (or adjust relative path based on component location) and cast as { shap_values: { severity: Record<string, Record<string, number>> } }
Define CORNERS = ['Copse', 'MB', 'Stowe', 'Club'] as const — these 4 corners have SHAP feature data in shap_data.json

For each lap key matching year+driver (format: '{year}_{driver}_{lapNum}', e.g. '2024_NOR_5'), compute per-corner stress: sum Math.abs(value) for all features in shap_values.severity[key] whose name starts with '{CORNER}_'. Result: stress[cornerIndex][lapIndex] = number
Normalize all stress values: find globalMax across all corners and laps, divide each by globalMax to get 0–1 range. If globalMax === 0 render a placeholder 'No data' text.
Render a div-based grid (not SVG): each row is a corner, each column is a lap sorted by lap_number ascending

Cell style: { width: Math.max(6, Math.min(10, 280 / numLaps)), height: 16, background: interpolateColor(v) } where interpolateColor(v) returns rgb string interpolating from rgb(13,17,23) at v=0 to rgb(255,24,1) at v=1 using linear lerp on each channel
Corner name labels on the left of each row: fontSize 8, color '#888', fontFamily monospace, width 36px, textAlign right, marginRight 4, lineHeight '16px'
X-axis lap number labels below the grid: show lap number every 5 laps, fontSize 7, color '#555', fontFamily monospace, positioned proportionally using the same cell width
Title above the grid: 'CORNER STRESS HEATMAP', fontSize 8, color '#888', letterSpacing 1, fontFamily monospace, marginBottom 4
Wrap everything in a div with style={{ overflowX: 'auto', maxWidth: '100%' }} to handle many laps

In dashboard/app/components/ScrollStage.tsx, import CornerHeatmap and render it inside the Predictors chapter section (chapter 2, activeChapter === 2), after the existing top-3 SHAP callout area. Add:
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: shap_data.json structure: { shap_values: { severity: { '2024_NOR_5': { featureName: shapValue, ... } } } }. Corner prefixes in feature names: 'Copse_' (e.g. Copse_TimeSec, Copse_EntrySpeed, Copse_PeakLatG), 'MB_' (e.g. MB_PeakLatG, MB_TimeSec), 'Stowe_' (e.g. Stowe_AvgLatG), 'Club_' (e.g. Club_TimeSec, Club_EntrySpeed). Sum abs(value) for all features starting with the corner prefix. Data exists for years 2021-2025, drivers NOR/RIC/PIA depending on year. The file is at dashboard/public/data/shap_data.json. Import path from dashboard/app/components/ is '../../public/data/shap_data.json'.
